messages.subject: RI-CLPM did not converge for some of multiple imputed datasets
parts:
Hi all,

I am running RI-CLPM in my 50 multiple imputed datasets. The RI-CLPM converged for some of multiple imputed datasets, but not for other multiple imputed datasets. May I ask if I could report the results of RI-CLPM using the ones that did converge?

Any comments and suggestions would be highly appreciated.

Thanks in advance,

Judy
